original_intent: Fix five critical issues in one PR with verified GitHub Actions
derived_intent: Measure the existing twenty-client broker contention test with bounded diagnostic waits and a finite target-specific aggregate budget
active_boundaries: Keep twenty concurrent clients, existing retries, all assertions and production timeouts unchanged
evidence: At published head c897d74523ac640695cbcc8f500aa59b235d2732, Actions job114266925260 independently passed the real-socket committed claim preparation test in18.04seconds, including competing mutation and same-request retry. The aggregate group_broker target then exhausted its300second budget in the pre-existing twenty-client contention test. Other GitHub Actions groups passed. Local direct bind remains permission-denied even after the normal execution escalation request; an independent escalated socket probe failed in the environment launcher before execution.

Strict all-feature group_broker Clippy, formatting and diff checks passed. The focused contention harness compiled and completed bounded setup locally in7.13seconds, but real Unix socket contention remains capability-unavailable. Independent review confirms unchanged twenty-client concurrency, request identities, retry policy and assertions, bounded owned-child cleanup, joining all clients before assertions, and Unix/non-Unix helper separation.
